description: Online 128x128 block FP8 weights for the routed experts, the shared experts and the dense MLPs of a BF16 checkpoint (vLLM --quantization online). Attention and KDA projections, latent projections, embeddings and the output head stay BF16. As FP8=1 FP8_SCOPE=mlp in the eth-cscs/alps-extended-images#67 launchers, with the Triton MoE backend and the same RunAI loader limits: online FP8 stages the BF16 weights in CPU memory, and without a 16 GiB buffer limit the four workers of a node ran out of host memory (job 5445598). Not for checkpoints that are already FP8, such as GLM-5.3.
